theorem: At fixed N=11, the affine two-parameter sextic construction gives at most fourteen permitted signed banks for every parameter pair with the explicitly defined polynomial P nonzero, over the sextic splitting field. P(0,0) has nonzero residue 17 modulo 23, so the permitted set is nonempty Zariski-open.
scope: Infinitely many realizations at fixed order eleven; no infinite family of transform orders, minimum, Q(q)-only nodes, or runtime advantage.
proof_basis: Exact coefficientwise affine recurrence verification, polynomial determinant/resultant guard, nonzero certified base point, and universal accepted edge, interpolation, reflection and inverse identities.
